liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Willie And The Hand Jive** (1 review): This is the first and only performance of this song, which the band handled well [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-04-04.140305.fm.miller.flac2496** (recommended): FM broadcast; 21 songs; 163 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: FM broadcast offers the best sound, with rich bass and deep ambiance despite minor clips [26]
- **gd1987-04-04.sbd.miller.95721.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 136 min; rated 2/5 by 1 [6]. Said about its sound: Soundboard is hissy with lots of audience noise, lacking dynamics compared to late 80s AUDs [16]
- **gd1987-04-04.176007.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 19 songs; 130 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [8]
- **gd1987-04-04.nak300.andrewf.78055.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 133 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [10]. Said about its sound: Reviewer ranks this audience recording among the top twenty or ten Dead AUDs ever [15]
- **gd1987-04-04.fob.nak700.rolfe.miller.99167.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 136 min; rated 3.62/5 by 8 [12]

## Around the show

- Heavy snow in DC forced hand-cancellation of mail-order tickets, denying some fans entry [17]
- Jerry attempted to sing the end of the song but his microphone was not working [18]
- A fan celebrated his 50th show with a special gift and a performance of Morning Dew [20]
- Crowd chanting for Phil before this song led to a rare, emotional band response [21]
- The show was a post-Garcia diabetic coma performance, starting hot with strong energy [23]
- Fans stayed at a friend's lake camp after the first night of the three-night run [26]
- These shows are considered the best of that year's tour, with pure playing [17]
- This show is the highlight of the Spring 87 East Coast run, the comeback tour [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-04-04.140305.fm.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: FM (WCUW) > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X90) [1]. Also: Recorded by the Grateful Dead crew using two sets of masters to complete the show [1]
- **gd1987-04-04.sbd.miller.95721.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette [6]
- **gd1987-04-04.176007.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME-80 mics > Sony D5M [8]
- **gd1987-04-04.nak300.andrewf.78055.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Andrew F.; transferred by Andrew F.; source: Nakamichi CM-300's with CP-4 shotgun capsules > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90 cassettes, with no Dolby [10]. Also: Patches from Shnid-9362 covered tape flips in Cassidy and Space using Soundforge [10]
- **gd1987-04-04.fob.nak700.rolfe.miller.99167.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Steve Rolfe; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Nakamichi 700 -> Sansui Tricode PCM Audio Processor -> Magnovox VCR [12]. Also: The first live performance of this song occurred on February 12, 1986 [22]
